why: I checked both must_catch items against the verifier brief. Item 2 holds. Check 2 runs the same three commands "at the PR's base commit (for example, check out the merge-base in a separate worktree)" and passes only if stdout, stderr and exit code match the base. Item 1 breaks. Check 4 says to "Run `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/`" and states "Only the live page counts." It tells the verifier to report FAIL if the PR is not merged. It does not check at the PR head that docs/index.md lists --shout and that pages.yml publishes docs/ from main. It also says "Do not mark this check PASS based on the diff or on docs/index.md." The pages.yml check appears only as an advisory item. That is the opposite of what item 1 requires, so the trap is not handled.
